Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in League City, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side
by Driver 2, who had entered the intersection from a crossing street. Driver 1 reported neck strain shortly after the
collision, and the described mechanism of injury is consistent with a side impact of this kind. A Passenger was also in
Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officer and the witnesses at the scene confirmed that the Passenger was
present at the time of impact. Scene photographs show damage to the driver's side panels and door that matches the
direction and force described by both drivers. No independent witnesses came forward, so the account of the collision
rests on the drivers' statements and the physical evidence. Driver 1 is named on the policy covering the vehicle.
Officers found no indication that the vehicle had sustained prior daamge in the affected areas, and no earlier damage
to the vehicle is known from available records.
